desktopPilot: For this pilot, order with a SORA wallet in a desktop browser.
title: Community Store
description: Lightly steamed green tea from Shizuoka, Japan.
frontPhoto: Front of the golden organic sencha package
backPhoto: Back of the sencha package with its ingredient and brewing label
shippingSeparate: Shipping calculated separately. Network fee shown before you sign.
launchPending: We’re preparing shipping and checkout. You can browse the tea while we get everything ready.
detailsBody: Organic loose leaf sencha from Shizuoka, Japan. Each sealed bag contains 100 g. Ingredients: organically grown green tea.
brewWater: Cool boiled water to 60°C or below.
brewLeaves: Use 4–5 g of leaves per person.
brewTime: Steep for about 1 minute 20 seconds, then pour completely.
storage: Store in a cool, dark place away from moisture. Enjoy promptly after opening. The best-before date on your delivered bag applies.
shippingBody: Volunteers source your tea in Japan and dispatch it sealed to supported destinations where shipping is legal. Delivery options and charges appear before payment. Customs and import requirements depend on your destination.
refundBody: If we can’t source or ship your tea, we refund the XOR received, including shipping, less the SORA fee for sending the refund. Network fees paid with the original order are not refundable. We’ll keep you updated while your refund is pending.
checkoutIntro: Your delivery details go privately to the store and its fulfillment volunteers. They are never written to the blockchain or published on IPFS.
noDestination: Don’t see your destination? Contact the store for a shipping inquiry before paying.
telegramHint: Use a username volunteers can message, not a numeric chat ID.
networkFee: Plus the network fee shown by your wallet
selectDestination: Choose a destination to see the full XOR total.
noShippingRate: No shipping option covers this quantity and destination. Please contact the store before paying.
termsAgree: I have checked my delivery details and accept the shipping, refund, and privacy terms.
recoveryKeep: Keep your order ID and private recovery code. They let you check your order on another device. Anyone with both can view its status; do not share them publicly.
newOrder: Save receipt & start a new order
paymentIntro: Payment goes directly from your wallet to the store. The transfer amount, wallet addresses and payment reference are public on-chain. Your delivery and contact details stay private.
shipped: Your tea is on its way
expiredBody: Do not send a new payment for this order. If you already paid, volunteers will review it.
reviewBody: We’re checking your payment and whether the tea can be sourced and shipped. Do not pay again; contact support with your order ID if you need help.
paidBody: We received your XOR. Volunteers will check shipping and contact you with the next update.
paymentPendingBody: Your transfer is being checked. You can keep this receipt and return later. Do not send another payment.
notificationPending: Your volunteer notification is queued and will retry automatically. Your order is safely recorded.
recoverBody: Use the order ID and private recovery code from your receipt to check payment, shipping, or a refund.
recoverRequired: Enter both your order ID and private recovery code.
paymentUnavailable: Payment is temporarily unavailable. Keep your receipt and check the order status before trying again.
formInvalid: Check your delivery and contact details before continuing.
noQuote: Choose a supported destination and quantity before continuing.
support: For support, write in {handle} on Telegram.
sourcedOnDemand: We buy your tea in Japan after you order.
showcasePhoto: A cup of Japanese green tea beside the golden sencha package
serviceUnavailable: Ordering is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later or contact the store.
saveFailed: Your order could not be confirmed. Retry with the same details or recover your saved order before paying.
statusUnavailable: We could not refresh this order. Keep your receipt and check again; do not pay again.
recoverFailed: We could not recover that order. Check your order ID and private recovery code, or contact the store.

widget.title: Pay with XOR
widget.idle: Connect your wallet to review the fee.
widget.ready: Review the payment details before sending.
widget.signing: Confirm in your wallet. Keep this page open.
widget.submitted: Transfer submitted. Waiting for finalized payment verification.
widget.uncertain: Payment status is uncertain. Check the saved order before taking any further payment action.
widget.finalized: Payment verified in a finalized block.
widget.error: Payment unavailable. Check your wallet, network, balance and quote expiry.
widget.feeChanged: The network fee changed. Review it and press Send XOR again.
widget.insufficientBalance: Not enough native XOR in this wallet to cover the payment and network fee.

refundedBody: Your refund is complete. See the refund transaction details below. Network fees paid with the original order were not refunded.
legacyRefundBody: If your tea cannot be sourced or shipped, we return the full XOR received for the order, including shipping, to the wallet that paid. The store covers the refund transaction fee. We’ll keep you updated while your refund is pending.
legacyRefundedBody: Your refund is complete. The full XOR received, including shipping, was returned to the wallet that paid. The store covered the refund transaction fee.
refundAmendedBody: For this refund, you agreed to a {amount} XOR deduction. The transfer amount below includes that deduction.
